description: The launch event, to be held at Lok Bhawan, will see the unveiling of two key industrial initiatives—the UP Private Business Park Development Scheme–2025 and the Plug-and-Play Industrial Sheds Scheme—designed to provide ready-to-use infrastructure to investors under a PPP framework.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will launch the upgraded single-window clearance portal, Nivesh Mitra 3.0, on March 24 in Lucknow, in a move aimed at further improving the state’s ease of doing business and accelerating its journey towards a $1 trillion economy.public-private partnership (PPP) framework.industrial projects in the state. AI-led upgrade to single-window system Positioned as a next-generation digital platform, Nivesh Mitra 3.0 integrates artificial intelligence and data-driven governance tools to streamline regulatory approvals.
